preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 8 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= ai <= 10**12 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer ai in the list a is between 2 and 10^12 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of vertices in the divisor tree is at least the number of integers n.

postconditions.expression: all(ai in divisor_tree_vertices for ai in a)
postconditions.description: Each integer ai in the list a is present in the vertices of the divisor tree.
All leaves in the divisor tree contain prime numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(parent_value == product(child_values) for parent_value, child_values in divisor_tree_edges)
postconditions.description: For each inner vertex in the divisor tree, its value is the product of its children's values.
